stories.title: Saudi Arabia issues first-ever emergency alert for Mecca after Houthi drone threat, declares holy cities a 'red line'
stories.reason: The alert, following missile and drone strikes that injured 13 civilians in Khamis Mushayt, Abha and Taif, marks the first time Islam's holiest city has been placed under threat warning since the Houthi campaign against Saudi Arabia intensified.

stories.title: Fed decision due today with markets pricing a 90% chance of the first rate hike since 2023
stories.reason: Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks and hot August inflation data have markets bracing for a hike despite direct pressure from Trump to cut, with today's dot plot and press conference set to shape rate expectations for the rest of the year.

stories.title: Sam Altman rules out an OpenAI IPO in 2026, citing AI safety concerns
stories.reason: Altman told Fortune a public listing now would be 'ill-advised' given the industry's safety debate, and said OpenAI has discussed pausing capability development to let safety work catch up -- a striking admission from one of AI's most aggressive labs.

stories.title: Kennedy Center board votes to shutter the venue, warns of bankruptcy unless Trump's name is added to the building
stories.reason: Trump's handpicked board says it has exhausted its funds and can't meet payroll without his personal fundraising help, which it says depends on inscribing his name on the facade -- a demand a federal judge has already rejected once.

stories.title: Cornelis Networks raises $205 million to challenge Nvidia's dominance in AI networking
stories.reason: The Intel spinoff's new Active Compute Fabric lets chips process and transmit data simultaneously to cut GPU idle time, with its 400Gbps switch shipping now and an 800Gbps generation sampling with customers ahead of a Q4 launch.

stories.title: Shanghai AI Laboratory quietly releases a 744-billion-parameter open-weight agentic model
stories.reason: Atria Dawn Preview appeared on GitHub with no announcement, built on the same GLM-5.2 base Z.ai already ships, underscoring how China's state-backed labs are iterating on open-weight agentic models even without US-style publicity.

stories.title: US debt nears $40 trillion as bond yields approach 19-year highs ahead of the Fed decision
stories.reason: Rising Treasury yields are colliding with a war-driven inflation squeeze and a resilient labor market that added 162,000 jobs in August, leaving the Fed little room to satisfy either markets or the White House today.

stories.title: Balochistan Liberation Army claims fresh attacks after IED kills three Pakistani security personnel
stories.reason: The Tump-area IED strike on a Frontier Corps vehicle is the latest in an escalating separatist insurgency that has killed dozens of security personnel and civilians across Pakistan's largest province this year.
